snippet.title: Mycopunk | Reveal Trailer | Four-Player Co-Op Chaos in a Fungal Future 🍄💥🔫
snippet.description:
Play the online multiplayer demo now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247750/Mycopunk

Your ragtag gang of robot rejects have been hired by the universal megacorp SAXON for one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). You are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

Embark on a series of dangerous planet-side missions to drive back the mycological menace. Could this be a simple natural disaster like they claim? And did SAXON really misfile your taxes? Or was that your own fault?

Who cares? You're underpaid, over-armed, and ready to clean house.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
